title: Add qwen3.6 to switchable models + model catalog, remove mistral:7b
summary: qwen3.6 is installed in Ollama and working but not switchable via /models. mistral:7b is configured as a fallback but not installed — it fails when selected. This change adds qwen3.6 to both the fallback chain and the model catalog with aliases, and removes mistral:7b entirely.

changes.note: Replace mistral:7b (not installed) with qwen3.6 (installed, 23GB local, tools+vision+thinking)

New model catalog/allowlist. Makes all 3 working models switchable via /models with short aliases. Excludes mistral:7b (not installed) and glm-5.1:cloud (not installed) and nomic-embed-text (embedding model, not a chat model).
Remove mistral:7b from provider catalog — not installed in Ollama, fails when selected

impact: All agents using agents.defaults.model will now fall back to qwen3.6 (local, 23GB) instead of mistral:7b (broken)
/models Discord picker will show 3 switchable models: glm-5.2:cloud, qwen3.6, kimi-k2.6:cloud
No agent-specific model configs are changed — agents with explicit primary/fallbacks (coo, cmo, cro, cto, etc.) keep their own settings
Note: agents with explicit fallbacks of ['ollama/glm-5.2:cloud'] are unaffected — their fallback stays the same
rollback: Restore from backup: cp ~/.openclaw/openclaw_backup_pre_qwen-mistral.json ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json && openclaw restart
